title: The Human skeleton. Part 3. Muscles, movements and pressure
creator_credit: Frank Wells, Gaumont-British Instructional and Beryl Denman Lacey
brief_description: Shows the workings of muscles and tendons within the human skeletal structure, with main emphasis on the diaphragm and the muscles required to maintain a human in an erect position.
